chunks: Say: "It is He who dispersed you all over the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God dispersing humanity on earth and gathering them back?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Tawhid al-Fi'l* (Unity of Divine Action), affirming that God is the sole agent who dispersed humanity to populate the earth. It highlights the transient nature of worldly existence as a preparation for the ultimate return (*Ma'ad*) to the Divine Presence, reinforcing the accountability of human deeds.
